cultural_notes: Lead with measurable customer value and proof points.
Avoid exaggerated superlatives unless supported by data.
Include availability, pricing or official website when possible.
risk_notes: Avoid absolute claims such as best, guaranteed, number one.

United Kingdom.media_style: measured, credible, practical, with understated tone
cultural_notes: Use a restrained tone and avoid over-selling.
Show local relevance and customer benefit early.
risk_notes: Check advertising and consumer protection wording.

Singapore.media_style: regional, business-oriented, innovation and trust focused
cultural_notes: Highlight Southeast Asia relevance and regional scalability.
Emphasize compliance, reliability and partner ecosystem.
risk_notes: Avoid treating Southeast Asia as one uniform market.

cultural_notes: Emphasize quality, reliability, service support and long-term trust.
risk_notes: Claims should be conservative and evidence-backed.

cultural_notes: Localize benefits around daily life, affordability and community trust.
Use clear language and avoid complex jargon.
Mobile and social channels are important.
risk_notes: Avoid sensitive cultural or religious references unless reviewed locally.

cultural_notes: Emphasize data protection, reliability, engineering quality and measurable benefits.
Use precise terminology and avoid hype.
risk_notes: Privacy and compliance wording must be reviewed.

France.media_style: polished, editorial, value and design oriented
cultural_notes: Balance innovation with brand taste and local relevance.
A more editorial tone may work better than pure sales copy.
risk_notes: Check translation elegance and cultural nuance.

cultural_notes: Emphasize accessibility, community, lifestyle and local availability.
Use an engaging but credible tone.
